stage.name: Moneymaking from Nothing
stage.description:
The Duck Lord manipulated these Collapsals to congregate here, roving around in a circle. A patch of land that should not be in Sami does appear dead-center in the altar, but has yet to bring any riches.
<Heat Pump Passages> that periodically deal damage to units above them are present on the field
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

tainted_carcass.name: Tainted Carcass
tainted_carcass.flavourText: A Sami warrior irreversibly corrupted by demons. He once went to the snow fields with a clear purpose, but is now completely bereft.
abilities: Movement Speed significantly increases for a short time after taking damage

distorted_caster.name: Distorted Caster
distorted_caster.flavourText: A Sami shaman possessed by demons. Everything they understood about nature has been reconstructed into pure nothingness.
abilities: Movement Speed significantly increases after not attacking for a period of time, resets on attack

duck_lord.name: Duck Lord
duck_lord.flavourText: A famous Columbian investor, entrepreneur, and master of 'Duck Power.' Out of the public eye, enjoys kicking back with others...
abilities: Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after being attacked
